Mila's patent record as captured here shows six granted patents, but the five most recent titles are kitchen fixtures, not AI research, indicating the applicant search matched a different entity.

The institute profile describes a nonprofit AI research community of more than 1,400 researchers, founded in 1993, with programs for policy training, startup support, and a venture arm. That profile is consistent with an AI research organization, but the dataset lists no products or cases for Mila, so it offers no direct measure of AI capability.

The patent titles, including a process for milling a kitchen sink, an air filter, a bain marie, and a side sink, are unrelated to machine learning. The source note says the query used the applicant phrase "mila", which likely captured a different organization. profile_text.body:
Mila is a nonprofit artificial intelligence research institute based in Montreal, Quebec, Canada, founded in 1993. According to its website, it brings together researchers from Université de Montréal, McGill University, Polytechnique Montréal and HEC Montréal, and describes itself as a community of more than 1,400 researchers specializing in machine learning. Its stated focus is scientific excellence and innovation within Quebec's AI ecosystem.

The site describes several programs beyond research. One supports AI startups at any time of the year with resources and tailored support. Another, offered by Mila and the Public Policy Forum, is aimed at policy and decision makers and is designed to help them navigate the opportunities and risks of AI; the next cohort will be held in French on September 1-2, 2026, at Mila. Mila also describes a venture arm that invests in founders working in deep tech, AI, STEM and beyond. Research work published on the site includes a generative cutout animation system that takes a skeletal animation and a text prompt as input, and QueStER, a method for generative keyword-based retrieval that trains a rewriting policy with reinforcement learning.

The record held on Mila lists no tracked products, no lawsuits and no MCP servers. Its profile entry records it as a nonprofit organization headquartered in Montreal, with mila.quebec as its website.
